notes: ACCESS: robots.txt (https://www.swooneditions.com/robots.txt) is a standard Magento User-agent:* file with no anthropic/Claude-specific disallow and no blanket Disallow:/ - only technical paths blocked (checkout, customer, search, admin, etc), so all tiers were permitted; no bot walls encountered. Direct HTTP fetch (tier a, requests) worked for robots.txt and the XML sitemap (media/sitemap.xml, 5515 URLs, static) but the homepage/category pages are a client-rendered React SPA (HTML shell is just <div id=root> plus JS bundles, no server-rendered nav/counts), so tier (a) could not see the mega-menu or listing counts. Escalated to tier (b) Playwright headless Chromium (networkidle + settle wait) to render the mega-menu, breadcrumbs, sidebar 'Shop By' filter lists, and each category page's own item-count text. Tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome was not needed. TREE: union of (1) all links from the rendered homepage mega-menu DOM, (2) the Home Accessories flyout and the /accessories landing page's own left-hand 'Shop By' sidebar (this surfaced extra candidate links - Cushions, Bedding, Speedy accessories - not present in the header mega-menu itself), (3) the XML sitemap used only to sanity-check slug shapes, (4) cross-checked against the already-validated Furniture.xlsx Swoon (SR49) rows to avoid re-emitting nodes already captured there as Furniture. QTY: rendered 'Items X - Y of Z' listing-count text on each verified category page (Playwright), h1/breadcrumb confirmed to match the requested node on every leaf recorded. EXCLUDED: Mirrors (accessories/mirrors) - Wall Decor/Decorative, not Textile/Storage. Cushions (accessories/cushions, only linked from the Accessories page's own sidebar) - dead link, resolves to the generic Home Accessories landing page (h1 'Add the finishing touches'), not a real Cushions listing; site currently has no live Cushions category. Bedding (both accessories/bedding and sleeping/bed-linen, linked from nav/footer) - both dead links, redirect to the general /sleeping Beds page (31 items, all bed frames/sofa beds, no linen products); no live standalone Bedding/Bed Linen textile category exists on the site today. Speedy accessories (accessories/speedy-accessories) - resolves to a delivery-facet filter URL (1-2 week delivery), not a distinct category; excluded as a filter/search view. Storage Furniture group (TV stands, Sideboards, Chests of drawers, Cabinets, Drinks cabinets, Wardrobes, Shelving, Shoe racks, Drinks trolleys under /storage/*) - already captured in the validated Furniture.xlsx under Swoon as Furniture (verified by reading the existing workbook rows); these are mango-wood/acacia/marble/brass furniture pieces that the site's own nav groups under a 'Storage' label, but per storage.md rule 21/27 (explicit Furniture classification takes precedence) and to avoid duplicating another category's nodes, they were skipped here. All room-based 'shop by room' landing pages (Living room, Bedroom, Dining room, Hallway, Home office, Kitchen, Bathroom, Outdoor, Essentials, Pattern Collection), and all New In / Clearance / Flash sale / Bestsellers / aesthetic (Industrial, Contemporary, Art Deco, Scandi, Mid-Century, Classic) pages - aggregator/collection/promotional views, excluded per View-All/Collection rule.
